datePlans.title: Books, art & a film
datePlans.description: An unhurried Al Quoz afternoon: browse Fiker, stop in a gallery, then choose a Cinema Akil screening. An NSSO suggestion, not a timed itinerary; confirm library access, gallery hours and your film booking independently.

datePlans.title: Courtyards & conversation

datePlans.title: Art, books & the Creek
datePlans.description: Two quieter cultural stops: Jameel's galleries and Mohammed Bin Rashid Library. General entry is listed as free at both, but check their separate opening days and visitor rules. Travel between the pins using official directions.

datePlans.title: Rain, then reading
datePlans.description: Book a Rain Room slot, then slow down at House of Wisdom. Drive between these two Sharjah destinations; this is a pairing idea, not a walking route or a claim about live traffic.

datePlans.title: Make something, keep a memory
datePlans.description: Choose a booked fragrance workshop or jewelry-arts class, browse L’ÉCOLE’s library if the schedules align, then pause for coffee at Qinwan. An editorial pairing, not a package: each activity has its own booking and price.
